notes.measured: No physical blank measured. Official PHONE envelope is a scaling reference only.
placeholder: No physical blank measured. Case envelope adds an estimated 1.6 mm side border and 4.0 mm depth allowance; back, corner radii, camera centres, hole sizes, button and port clearances remain photo-based estimates.

Interior fit, camera recesses and speaker/microphone/USB-C clearances require exact blank measurements. Bottom layout is a provisional USB-C/speaker interpretation, not a hole-by-hole manufacturing drawing.
No external magnetic groove inferred from seller illustrations of hidden magnets. Internal magnetic hardware is not modeled.
Camera holes are separate openings with covered material between them. Raised pill dimensions and shoulder transition are estimated.
UVs and printable areas are draft preview coordinates, not a validated manufacturing dieline.
A 0.001 mm weld removes coincident boolean slivers at the flash cut; topology and UVs are checked after cleanup.
